description: Siddiqsons Tin Plate Limited, incorporated in 1996 within the Siddiqsons group, describes itself as Pakistan's first and only tin plate producer. Its plant at Windhur in Balochistan, established in 1999 with Sollac of France and Mitsubishi Corporation of Japan, has capacity for 120,000 tonnes a year of tin plate produced by the Ferrostan electrolytic process, for cans and containers used in cooking oil, food, beverage and lubricant packaging. A canning plant at Malir, Karachi makes the finished containers.
headOffice: Ocean Tower, 27th Floor, Plot G-3, Block 9, Near II Talwar, Clifton, Karachi
